name: mode
label: Mode
hint: Upcoming shows what's next; Past is the archive by year

name: type
label: Event type
hint: Which kind of event to list

name: limit
label: Maximum events
hint: Defaults to 1 for Upcoming and no limit for Past. 0 means no limit

name: heading
label: Heading
hint: Defaults to "Next Town Hall" or "Town Hall Notes and Recordings" when empty

name: empty_message
label: Empty message
hint: Shown when there are no events. Defaults to a short note for the mode
